question.title: Locate the Lone Deposit
question.content:
(This problem is an interactive problem.)

A bank keeps a sealed ledger, an array of non-negative integers in which exactly one entry is non-zero. You cannot read the ledger directly. You may only use the SealedLedger interface, which the judge implements:

  • SealedLedger.size() returns the number of entries.
  • SealedLedger.rangeSum(from, to) returns the sum of the entries from index from to index to, both inclusive.

Return the index of the non-zero entry. Submissions making more than 40 calls to rangeSum will be judged Wrong Answer.

The examples show the sealed array for clarity. Your code receives only the interface.

 

Example 1:

Input: ledger = [0,0,7,0]
Output: 2

Example 2:

Input: ledger = [5]
Output: 0

Example 3:

Input: ledger = [0,3,0,0,0,0]
Output: 1

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= ledger.length <= 106
  • 0 <= ledger[i] <= 109
  • Exactly one entry of ledger is non-zero.
